axes.label: 웨어러블 전기화학 바이오센서
axes.claim: 땀이나 조직액에서 대사물질을 연속 측정하는 웨어러블 전기화학 센서의 최근 보고를 모은다.

items.claim: Enzyme-loaded polymeric matrices combined with carbon nanomaterials and metallic nanoparticles in a wearable multisensing patch enable simultaneous monitoring of glucose, lactate and H2O2.
items.quote: enables real-time, highly sensitive, and simultaneous monitoring of key clinical biomarkers (e.g., glucose, lactate, and H2O2) in clinical and point-of-care applications
items.title: A Flexible Wearable Multisensing Patch Integrating SWCNT-PtNPs Nanocomposites for Non-Invasive Clinical Biomarkers Monitoring in Sweat

items.claim: Enzyme-based electrochemical biosensors have significantly improved diabetes management, but their widespread clinical application remains limited by enzyme instability.
items.quote: Conventional glucose monitoring technologies, particularly enzyme-based electrochemical biosensors, have significantly improved diabetes management; however, their widespread clinical application remains limited by enzyme instability
items.title: Next-generation nanobiosensors enable dynamic, real-time glucose monitoring for precision diabetes therapy

items.claim: Hydrogels give wearable biosensors tissue-like softness, adhesion and biocompatibility, while nanomaterials such as graphene, carbon nanotubes and MXenes enhance conductivity and signal amplification.
items.quote: Hydrogels provide tissue-like softness, hydration, adhesion, permeability, and biocompatibility, whereas nanomaterials such as graphene, carbon nanotubes, MXenes, metallic nanoparticles, and conductive polymers enhance conductivity
items.title: Hydrogel-and-Nanomaterial-Integrated Wearable Biosensors for Real-Time Biomedical Monitoring: Materials, Devices, and IoT-Connected Systems

axes.label: 신축성 전도체와 액체금속
axes.claim: 신축성 배선과 액체금속 기반 전도체의 최근 보고를 모은다.

items.claim: A poor solvent-induced interfacial self-assembly strategy produced elastic conductors with a liquid metal polymer interpenetrating conductive domain, reaching a conductivity of 3.33 x 10^6 siemens per meter and stretchability beyond 1400% strain.
items.quote: the conductors achieve exceptional conductivity (3.33 × 10 6 siemens per meter), extreme stretchability (>1400% strain)
items.title: Highly conductive and ultrarobust elastic conductors for stretchable electronics

items.claim: Controlling the interparticle liquid bridge force and the critical rupture strength of liquid metal particle shells drives spontaneous fusion, giving stretchable conductive films on complex micro-structured surfaces.
items.quote: By precisely controlling the interparticle liquid bridge force and the critical rupture strength of liquid metal (LM) particle shells, the spontaneous fusion of LM particles is realized
items.title: High-performance stretchable conductive film on complex microscale structures via spontaneous fusion of liquid metal

items.claim: The practical use of liquid metal based stretchable conductors is limited by high material costs and susceptibility to leakage, which a multilayer architecture that decouples mechanical strain from electrical conduction addresses.
items.quote: Liquid-metal (LM)-based stretchable conductors are promising for soft electronics, yet their practical use is limited by high material costs and susceptibility to leakage.
items.title: Ultralow-Loading Multilayer Liquid Metal Conductors with Leakage Immunity and Uncompromised Electro-Mechanical Performance

axes.label: EIS 기반 센싱과 센서 진단
axes.claim: 임피던스 분광법으로 생체 신호를 측정하거나 센서 상태를 진단한 최근 보고를 모은다.

items.claim: In impedimetric aptamer biosensors, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy is analysed through charge transfer resistance, double-layer capacitance and diffusion-limited processes modelled with equivalent circuits, and microfluidic integration is presented as a way to enhance analyte transport.
items.quote: charge transfer resistance, double-layer capacitance, and diffusion-limited processes modeled through equivalent circuits
items.title: Physical fundamentals of aptamer-based impedimetric biosensors with integrated microfluidics

items.claim: A portable electrochemical impedance spectroscopy platform with ZnO-modified gold electrodes detected interleukin-6 and E-selectin label-free directly in human plasma.
items.quote: we present a portable electrochemical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) biosensing platform for the label-free detection of interleukin-6 (IL-6) and E-selectin directly in human plasma
items.title: Linking cytokine signaling to vascular response: Impedance biosensing of E-selectin and IL-6 for endothelial activation assessment

items.claim: A single-use tetrapolar electrochemical impedance spectroscopy biosensor based on a gold microband electrode functionalised with a self-assembled monolayer, protein G and antibodies quantified meropenem in spiked human serum.
items.quote: The sensor is based on a gold microband electrode functionalised with a self-assembled monolayer, protein G and anti-meropenem antibodies to enable selective antigen capture and impedance-based quantification.
items.title: Therapeutic drug monitoring of meropenem in human serum using a sensitive four-electrode electrochemical biosensor for critically ill patients in intensive care wards

axes.label: 웨어러블 미세유체 시료 채취
axes.claim: 웨어러블 센서에 시료를 공급하는 미세유체 구조의 최근 보고를 모은다.

items.claim: For wearable ion-selective electrode platforms, performance in standard solutions does not guarantee reliable on-body data, because distortion can arise before sweat contacts the electrode, at the electrochemical interface, and during signal acquisition and interpretation.
items.quote: performance in standard solutions does not guarantee reliable on-body data. During exercise, measurement distortion can arise before sweat contacts the electrode, at the electrochemical interface
items.title: Preserving Sample, Interface, and Signal Fidelity in Wearable Sweat Electrolyte Monitoring During Exercise

items.claim: A wearable surface-enhanced Raman scattering device combined chronometric microfluidics using capillary burst valves with interpretable machine learning to decode sweat biochemistry for fatigue assessment.
items.quote: we develop a fully integrated wearable surface-enhanced Raman scattering device that synergizes chronometric microfluidics with interpretable machine learning to decode sweat biochemistry for a precise fatigue assessment
items.venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society
items.title: Flexible Microfluidic Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering Devices Integrated with Interpretable Machine Learning for Metabolic Fatigue Monitoring

items.claim: For a sweat sensor, strong affinity between the recognition probe and the target and reversible binding are often mutually contradictory requirements.
items.quote: these two properties are often mutually contradictory since strong affinity usually gives rise to slow or irreversible dissociation
items.title: Wearable Microfluidic Chip Integrated with Chrono-Sampling for Cortisol Detection in Sweat

axes.label: 생체 접촉 계면 코팅
axes.claim: 센서 표면의 부착 방지와 안정성을 다룬 계면 코팅의 최근 보고를 모은다.

items.claim: Nanomaterials improve biosensors primarily through engineered interfaces that govern target capture, signal transfer and operational stability, rather than through material identity alone.
items.quote: Nanomaterials improve biosensors primarily through engineered interfaces that govern target capture, signal transfer, and operational stability, rather than through material identity alone.
items.title: Design rules of interface engineered nanomaterials for enhanced sensitivity stability and translational performance in bioanalytical biosensing

items.claim: A polyethylene glycol and chitosan composite coating on an optical microfiber coupler provided antifouling properties and biocompatibility at the same time.
items.quote: the multifunctional coating simultaneously provides antifouling properties, biocompatibility, and enzymatic specificity
items.title: U-shaped Sagnac optical microfiber coupler biosensor for dual-matrix glucose detection

axes.label: 바이오센서 신호의 기계학습
axes.claim: 바이오센서 신호를 기계학습으로 보정하거나 분류한 최근 보고를 모은다.

items.claim: Artificial intelligence is being applied to biosensing to overcome drawbacks of traditional biosensors such as noise interference, signal drift and the inability to process non-linear biological data.
items.quote: overcoming significant drawbacks of traditional biosensors, including noise interference, signal drift, and inability to process non-linear biological data
items.title: AI-driven biosensing technology for early disease detection: A comprehensive review

items.claim: A smart biosensing ecosystem integrates biorecognition elements, functional nanomaterials and electrochemical or optical transducers with data-driven methods, in response to the limitations of conventional single-analyte biosensing.
items.quote: functional nanomaterials, and electrochemical or optical transducers are integrated with chemometric preprocessing, machine-learning-based interpretation, IoT connectivity, and cloud-enabled decision support
items.title: Smart biosensing ecosystems: Integrating nanotechnology, chemometrics, and machine learning for precision analytical applications
